stops.name: Schloss Genhoes
stops.detail: Genhoes Castle (Dutch: Kasteel Genhoes, Limburgish: Kesjtièl Genhoes) in the Alt-Valkenburg district of the Limburg municipality of Valkenburg aan de Geul is a moated castle that was built in its current form between the 15th and 18th centuries.

stops.name: Kellergeschoss
stops.detail: It is unclear when a permanent house or castle was first located at the current site, but by the 12th/13th century at the latest, a residential tower stood there, remains of which are preserved in today's basement level.

stops.name: Westflügel
stops.detail: In addition, Thimus had the late Gothic west wing repaired and modernized, including installing new windows, putting on a new roof, and laying new parquet flooring inside as well as installing paneling with carved decorations.
